themes.title: Crypto turns higher with stocks
themes.summary: Bitcoin lagged the early stock rebound but moved up by midday as the Nasdaq rose about 2% on an AI and chip rally led by CoreWeave.

themes.title: ETF outflows slow
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs lost about $95 million on Tuesday, a fourth straight day of outflows but smaller than prior days; spot Ether ETF outflows fell to about $1.3 million Tuesday from $185 million Monday.

themes.title: Rate-hike expectations weigh
themes.summary: After hotter-than-expected October CPI, a quarter-point Fed hike in December is the base case, which has lifted the dollar and yields.

themes.title: Futures positioning builds
themes.summary: Bitcoin futures open interest rose to about 493,000 BTC, the highest since Aug. 19, while liquidations jumped to about $725 million over 24 hours earlier in the day.

themes.title: Sentiment stays fearful
themes.summary: CoinGecko's Fear & Greed gauge reads 'Fear' at 35, and CoinMarketCap's reads 25; Nexo described Bitcoin's overnight dip as a three-month low.

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin rose about 1.4% and Ether about 2.5% over 24 hours; Solana and Hyperliquid each rose about 3.1% (CoinGecko).

categories.name: Privacy coins
categories.note: Zcash fell about 11.5% and Monero about 7.1% over 24 hours (CoinMarketCap), extending Tuesday's liquidation-driven decline.

categories.name: Memecoins / broad altcoins
categories.note: The CoinDesk Memecoin Index fell 1.2% early Wednesday and the Altcoin Season Index sat at 40; Pepe was up about 1.9% (CoinMarketCap).

categories.name: Tokenized assets / RWA
categories.note: CoinMarketCap's Tokenized Assets category was up about 4.5% and Real World Assets Protocols about 3.0% over 24 hours.

watch_list.why: Another inflation reading ahead of the Fed's Dec. 8–9 meeting, where a rate hike is widely expected.

watch_list.topic: Whether BTC holds above Tuesday's low near $72,700
